rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Conditional probability restricts the sample space to the given event.
P(A∩B) = P(A) · P(B|A).

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: For independent events P(B|A) = P(B).  ·  Tree diagrams encode multiplication along branches and addition across outcomes.
